title: Director of Marketing
description:
Director of Marketing
Parsley Health · Marketing · Remote US, with a preference for Eastern or Central time zones and NYC metro · Full-time
About Parsley Health
Parsley Health is rebuilding primary care around root-cause, whole-person medicine. Our members get board-certified clinicians, health coaches, advanced testing, and a care platform that connects the dots across all of it.
We are a mostly virtual medical practice with care available across the country, and we recently expanded in-network access nationwide. As we grow, we are continuing to improve how we connect growth, care delivery, member experience, and financial performance so we can make better decisions and scale sustainably.
About the role
The Director of Marketing owns Parsley's full growth engine with the goal of acquiring more members efficiently. This is a high-visibility role in the driver's seat of Parsley's growth. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you'll run the channels that drive acquisition today and make sure brand investment shows up in conversion, CAC, and LTV.
We’re looking for a growth marketer with proven results, and with a strong track record of leveraging brand, trust, and storytelling lower acquisition cost and lift conversion, and who manages them accordingly.
What you’ll own
You'll lead a team of in-house specialists, agencies, and contractors to deliver on:

•
Growth channels: Own paid media (our primary channel), SEO, lifecycle, and affiliate. Set strategy, budget allocation, and testing priorities, and manage our paid media agency to CAC and payback targets.

•
Membership join flow and CRO: Partner with the Growth Product Manager on join-flow and site conversion, and align on a shared testing roadmap.

•
Brand, content, and PR: Partner with the Brand Manager on brand strategy and content, and with our PR agency on earned media, so all of it builds demand and trust that show up in conversion and CAC.

•
Measurement and planning: Own the marketing plan, budget, and forecast by channel. Define how the brand contributes to growth, report weekly on funnel performance, and make clear reallocation calls.

What we’re looking for

• 8+ years in growth marketing, with 3+ years leading a multi-channel team at a DTC, subscription, or consumer health company.

• Hands-on ownership of paid media budgets and agency management against CAC and payback targets.

• Direct experience scaling affiliate, SEO, and/or lifecycle/CRM.

• A track record of using brand, content, or PR to move growth metrics

• Strong data fluency, including using AI tools to self-serve and scale both campaigns and analytics.

• Comfortable being both strategist and operator on a lean team

• Healthcare, telehealth, or wellness experience preferred

• Experience marketing insurance-covered services preferred

• Experience partnering with a sales team on lead-to-purchase conversion

Compensation & Benefits
Parsley Health is committed to providing an equitable, fair, and transparent compensation program for all employees.
The starting salary for this role is between $160,000 and $190,000 , depending on skills and experience. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, scope, and internal equity relative to peers at the company.
Benefits include

• Equity stake for all employees based on role level

• 401(k) + employer matching program

• Hybrid opportunity with remote work and time on site at our NYC HQ

• Complimentary Parsley Health Complete Care membership

• Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

• Generous flexible time off plan

• Annual professional development stipend

• Annual wellness stipend

title: People Programs Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

People Programs at Ramp builds the programs that shape how employees experience the company day to day; from someone's first week to the moments that define Ramp's culture company-wide. As Ramp scales, we need someone dedicated to building that function and taking our foundations to the next level.

In this role, you'll own programs like onboarding, manager enablement, engagement surveys, and the company-wide culture and recognition programs that shape how Ramp works, to name a few. You'll work closely with People Business Partners, People Operations, and Comms to make these programs land and thrive.

This work is high impact and high visibility. This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone with strong judgment who owns things fully.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own roadmap by pulling signal from engagement survey results, PBP and manager input, and People Ops, then make the call on what to build, improve, delegate, or stop.

- Own onboarding effectiveness - from pre-start through the first week - so every new hire's first experience of Ramp reflects how we work and our culture, partnering with People Ops and IT on day-to-day logistics

- Own the performance review cycle's program design - timeline, tools, and the manager/employee experience - partnering with PBPs on calibration and outcomes

- Build and own manager enablement as a standalone program: design the content, frameworks, and moments that help managers lead well, in partnership with PBPs on delivery

- Conceive, build, and run company-wide culture-building programs, fully owning logistics and content end-to-end

- Own recognition programming: how we surface and celebrate what's worth celebrating across the company and the rituals/milestones that make Ramp's culture tangible day to day

- Own the biannual engagement survey: design, run, and work with People Business Partners to translate results into action

- Be the trusted voice on what we should build in-house versus buy (tools, vendors, platforms) for people programs, grounded in judgment about what's worth the investment, not a default toward either

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years owning people/culture programs end-to-end at a high-growth company - from ideation through hands-on execution

- A builder's track record: you've created programming that didn't exist before, not adapted someone else's playbook

- Strong facilitation and executive presence. You’re comfortable being the face of a program in front of the whole company, not just behind the scenes

- Comfortable with data: you can read engagement survey results and program metrics and turn them into a point of view, not just a report

- Proven ability to partner across functions (PBPs, Comms, Enablement, leadership)

- First-principles thinker who can turn ambiguity into a scalable framework: you don't need a rule book, but you can build one when it's missing

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

title: Associate Director, Retail Media Search
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary & Impact

The Associate Director, Commerce Search will lead retail media search strategy and activation for a beauty-focused client portfolio, with an emphasis on navigating the unique commerce ecosystems of specialty retailers and department stores.

We’re looking for a commerce marketer who understands that retail media goes beyond Amazon and Walmart. The ideal candidate brings experience working with beauty, luxury, fashion, or similarly retail-driven brands and understands how brands engage consumers across retailers such as Ulta Beauty, Sephora, Macy’s, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s, and other specialty and department-store environments.

In this role, you’ll translate retailer, consumer, product, inventory, and performance insights into smart search and commerce activation strategies. You’ll lead campaign strategy and execution, develop keyword and optimization approaches, manage retail media investments, and partner directly with clients, retailers, and internal teams to drive measurable business results.

You’ll also manage and develop a team while helping clients navigate an increasingly complex retail media landscape. Strong retail media experience is essential; beauty or adjacent specialty retail experience is highly preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Lead search and retail media strategy and activation across multiple retailer environments.

• Own keyword strategy, campaign setup, bidding, budgeting, optimization, testing, and performance reporting.

• Bring a strong understanding of specialty and department-store commerce, particularly how brands drive growth across retailer partners.

• Translate retail considerations such as inventory, product availability, demand, profitability, promotions, and seasonality into media recommendations.

• Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, retailer media partners, and internal teams.

• Identify opportunities to connect retail search with the broader commerce and media ecosystem.

• Use performance data to identify trends and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Lead cross-channel testing and optimization strategies.

• Manage and develop direct reports, helping strengthen both their activation expertise and strategic capabilities.

• Stay ahead of developments across retail media platforms, ad products, technology, and measurement.

• Oversee campaign operations, including trafficking, billing/reconciliation, and data integrity.

Experience

• 5+ years of retail media, commerce search, paid ecommerce, or biddable performance media experience, with substantial hands-on retail search experience.

• Strongly preferred: experience supporting beauty, cosmetics, luxury, fashion, or another category heavily connected to specialty and department-store retail.

• Experience working with specialty retailers and/or department stores. Beauty retailer experience is especially relevant.

• Hands-on experience managing retail media/search campaigns and optimizing toward business and performance objectives.

• Experience across retail media and commerce platforms such as Amazon Ads, Criteo, Walmart Connect, Pacvue, and Skai, or comparable platforms.

• Strong understanding of how inventory, profitability, product availability, promotions, forecasting, and demand influence commerce media decisions.

title: Office Coordinator, PHL (Fixed-Term/ Part-Time)
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

We are looking for a highly talented and motivated Office Coordinator who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment. 

As our Office Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role not only in keeping the office running smoothly and efficiently, but inspiring morale and team building. We are scaling aggressively and our Office Coordinators are a strong foundation to making sure our organization stays inclusive, safe and fun! 

This role is part-time and onsite in our Philly office - no opportunity for remote or hybrid.

What You'll Do

• Work cross functionally with Workplace, Sales, and IT teams to ensure the office is running smoothly.

• Drive internal and external meetings - coordination, scheduling, organizing and event planning. 

• Be an ambassador for all visitors.

• Understand prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines.

• Assist Workplace team with supply ordering & restocking office supplies and snacks as needed.

• Ad Hoc requests that support the sales teams.

What You Bring

• Proficiency in Google Suite.

• Unparalleled work ethic: a willingness to go above and beyond is key.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Project Management: you are organized, take ownership, plan & execute with a follow through before a deadline.

title: Analytics Engineer 5 - Ads Identity & Signals
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
In 2022 we launched a new lower-priced, ad-supported tier, and we are building an in-house, world-class ad-tech ecosystem to give our members more choice and to offer advertisers a premium, better-than-linear-TV experience. We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix .

The Identity & Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business - the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign.

This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction - designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end-to-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company.

In This Role, You Will

• Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first-party and third-party signals.

• Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift.

• Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns.

• Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models.

• Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality.

• Translate identity graph and matching concepts - nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching - into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work.

• Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data.

• Experience working with graph data structures and graph-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores).

• Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts - deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation.

• Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining prod

title: Sr. Applied ML Engineer
description:
At Memory Bridge , we’re tackling one of the hardest problems in AI: Large language models perfect memory while preserving user privacy.
We’re looking for an exceptional ML Engineer who sees beyond simple RAG tutorials and understands that building production-grade memory systems requires deep software engineering expertise first, ML knowledge second. You’ll architect and build the core retrieval engine that powers personalized AI experiences across conversations, privacy-aware filtering, and adaptive memory updates.
This is a rare opportunity to join our team as the founding ML engineer, where your code will directly shape how AI systems remember and learn. If you’re a strong programmer who has evolved into NLP/ML, we should talk.
About You

• The ideal candidate has evolved from senior software development into NLP/ML, bringing the architectural thinking and code craftsmanship needed to tackle complex memory persistence, multi-tier retrieval, and real-time personalization challenges that separate production systems from proof-of-concepts.

• You champion frequent deployments. You believe in shipping code regularly and improving through real-world feedback rather than seeking perfection.

• You solve problems creatively. You tackle challenges with a can-do attitude, recognizing when to build new features versus strengthening foundations.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the core memory subsystem architecture, including storage tiers, retrieval pipelines, and privacy-aware filtering mechanisms

• Build evaluation frameworks to measure memory retrieval quality, relevance scoring, and augmentation effectiveness with clear metrics and benchmarks

• Implement sophisticated memory extraction and classification systems that identify, rank, and surface relevant user context from chat histories

• Research and adapt cutting-edge memory architectures from academic papers and open-source implementations (e.g., MemGPT, Reflexion, cognitive architectures)

• Architect the memory update pipeline that learns from user interactions, including relevance feedback, correction mechanisms, and adaptive privacy classification

• Design hybrid search strategies that combine semantic embeddings with structured metadata, graph relationships, and temporal patterns for optimal memory retrieval

• Collaborate with PM to define technical constraints and feasibility for memory system features

• Takes ownership of production reliability for AI features-comfortable being on-call for prompt failures, extraction issues, or integration breakdowns

• Understanding of AI system failure modes and fallback strategies-knows when to gracefully degrade vs. retry vs. escalate to human review

Requirements (Must-haves)

• 5+ years total experience, with at least 3 years in software engineering and 2 years building ML/NLP systems

• Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems with a focus on context management, memory persistence, or personalization features

title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

 

- Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

- High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

- Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

- Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics. You will partner with our Data Science team to architect the runtime infrastructure that serves predictive models and machine learning algorithms directly within our sub-millisecond real-time ad targeting engine.

- Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

- Plus: Cloud Resilience & Tooling: Hands-on experience with continuous profiling (e.g., Pyroscope, goroutine dumps), chaos engineering drills, and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, or AWS cloud networking.

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework-providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.

You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.

The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy-you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.

You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

• Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.

• Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.

• Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.

• Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.

• Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.

• Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.

• Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.

• Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.

• Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

• Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable service

About the team

Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls.

About the role

You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk.

In this role, you will:

- Drive assigned engagements from intake and agreement execution through purchasing, ongoing obligations, amendments, renewals, final payments, and closeout.

- Design, implement, and manage workflow automation and AI agents, partnering with technical teams where needed; own testing, adoption, monitoring, exception handling, and appropriate human review and approval controls.

- Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber.

- Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Have built repeatable processes in an ambiguous environment and use procurement, contract management, and ERP systems and operational data to improve execution.

- Have delivered workflow automation or AI agent solutions with measurable results and can manage their reliability, exceptions, and controls.

• Continuously evaluate emerging attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and offensive security tools to enhance penetration testing capabilities and address evolving threats.

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:

• Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance

• Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.

This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery ownership

- Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.

- Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.

- Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.

- Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

Stakeholder management

- Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.

- Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.

- Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

People leadership

- Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.

- Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.

- Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

Process and data

- Make sure the team follows the agreed recruitment process, with accurate and complete data in the applicant tracking system.

- Use dashboards and reports to find bottlenecks across the hiring funnel (submission → interview → selection → joining) and fix them.

- Keep offer and post-selection drop-outs low, and lead root-cause reviews when they rise.

Quality and candidate experience

- Raise screening quality so clients see fewer, better-matched profiles.

- Make sure every candidate receives timely updates and a clear outcome.

Sourcing channels

- Work closely with the central sourcing team on role allocation, handovers and turnaround time.

- Make effective use of job boards, referrals, vendor partners and internal talent pools.

Reporting

- Prepare monthly account and team performance reviews for leadership, with clear commentary on trends and actions.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Selections and joiners against target

- Time to first qualified profiles on priority roles

- Submission-to-interview and interview-to-selection conversion

- Offer and post-selection drop-out rates

- Joiner retention in the first 30 days

- Team productivity and data quality

- Stakeholder satisfaction (Sales and client feedback)

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- 8-12 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years leading recruiters or team leads against delivery targets.

- A strong background in IT recruitment or staffing (contract, permanent or managed services), ideally for international clients.

- A proven record of meeting hiring targets, which you can back with your own numbers.

- Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.

- Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.

- A coaching leadership style that balances accountability with development.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

- Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.

- Experience working with European clients and across time zones.

- Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.

- Experience managing recruitment vendors.

- Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer
description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY & SOURCELIGHT

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

- Develop a strategic supplier ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers across specialized technical categories, particularly high-value optical, laser, mechanical, electrical, and other advanced hardware components.

- Own sourcing and commercial negotiations: Lead supplier selection, RFQs, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, lead-time agreements, and framework contracts to secure favorable terms while balancing cost, quality, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.

- Manage complex technical agreements: Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supplier agreements and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), partnering with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership to ensure appropriate commercial, operational, and contractual outcomes.

- Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

title: Tech Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Talent Acquisition at Preply is a high-performing, ambitious team, deeply embedded in the business. We’re intentional about raising the bar: we iterate, use data, test new ideas, and learn together so we can hire the people who will help Preply keep powering progress.

We’re technology-driven, data-informed, and focused on hiring against business priorities and outcomes. Just as importantly, we’re team-first: collaborative, supportive, low-ego, and committed to building something meaningful together.

Building a legendary company should be fun.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As Preply continues to scale, Engineering remains at the core of our product, growth, and future. We're expanding technical hiring across complex domains and global tech hubs - and we're looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager - Tech to help us build a hiring engine that can match that ambition.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll directly manage a team of TA Partners with full reporting lines, while also personally owning complex engineering searches. You'll stay close to the craft, but your impact will go beyond individual roles: you'll help turn workforce plans into clear hiring priorities, translate those priorities into smart hiring strategies, and build the processes that allow us to hire exceptional talent with speed, quality, and focus.

You'll partner closely with TA Leadership, Engineering Directors, VPs, and our CTO to understand what the business needs, where the biggest hiring bets are, and how we should sequence work across domains and hubs. You'll own the full hiring rhythm: planning, sourcing strategy, pipeline health, calibration, weekly progress tracking, issue-spotting, and continuous improvement.

It's a great fit for someone who has already managed a tech recruitment function and team, and wants to grow within an environment that moves and scales fast, and holds a genuinely high quality bar.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the Engineering hiring engine end to end: understand and collaborate on workforce plans, clarify hiring priorities, translate them into hiring strategies, and make sure the team is set up to deliver against business needs.

- Directly manage a team of TA Partners: full ownership of their performance, development, clear direction and priorities, coaching on search strategy and stakeholder management, and unblocking execution where needed.

- Drive hiring outcomes across technical domains and hubs: take accountability for progress, quality, and delivery across Engineering hiring in our main hubs Barcelona, London and Kyiv, while personally owning a couple of complex and high-impact searches.

- Build and optimize hiring processes: identify what slows us down, where quality drops, or where ownership is unclear - then improve the process so we can hire top talent in the most effective way.

- Track progress through data: run a strong weekly hiring rhythm, using funnel data, pipeline quality, pass-through rates, time in stage, sourcing performance, and stakeholder feedback to understand what's working and what needs to change.

title: FPGA Engineer
description:
Tomorrow.io is a leading weather intelligence and climate resilience platform helping organizations and governments make better decisions in a world of increasing weather volatility. By combining proprietary satellite technology, advanced AI forecasting models, and actionable analytics, Tomorrow.io delivers hyper-local weather insights that protect lives, strengthen operations, and build climate resilience globally.

Our space program is core to this mission. We are building and operating a weather observation constellation powered by internally developed sensing technologies - transforming how atmospheric data is captured and used worldwide.

Tomorrow.io is seeking an FPGA Engineer to aid in the design, development, and verification of digital systems on our proprietary weather sensing satellites. In this role, you will translate high level design requirements into concrete digital logic designs and contribute to the development of our custom electronic hardware. You will join a collaborative, high-performing environment that values technical excellence, shared accountability, and the pursuit of ambitious, mission-driven engineering goals.

What You’ll Do

• Design, develop, and verify RTL code for FPGAs

• Develop and execute plans for PCBA bring up, track and troubleshoot issues

• Propose and trade design changes weighing technical, cost and schedule to align with program needs

• Collaborate with radar and RF engineers to derive and manage parent and child requirements

• Co-develop performance test plans, author and execute test procedures for verification and validation of radar components and subsystem

• Collaborate with other firmware, software and hardware designers to contribute to new PCBA designs

• Provide peer review of engineering products for digital circuits, PCBA, hardware and firmware

• Participate in weekly sprint planning, workload leveling, and effort estimation for design and testing tasks

• This is an onsite role in our Golden office 4 days/week

What You Bring

• Bachelors or Masters degree in Science Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM degrees) minimum of Bachelors required

• Master's degree a plus

• 3+ years of experience designing FPGAs and digital electronics hardware

• Thorough understanding of hardware description languages (HDL) and digital design and verification tools

• Candidate must have System Verilog or VHDL literacy

• UVM, UVVM, or OSVM experience is a plus

• Sufficient knowledge of PCBA design to contribute effectively to hardware design reviews

• Familiarity working in a lab environment and with ESD protocols

• Knowledge of and experience with test instruments such as oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, digital multimeters, and spectrum analyzers

• Knowledge of high-speed digital interface standards such as PCIe, DDR4/5, JESD204B/C, and 10 BASE-T ethernet

• Familiarity with digital signal processing techniques in remote sensing applications

• Awareness of EDA software (Altium preferred) and the PCB design lifecycle

Joining Tomorrow.io as an FPGA Engineer means:

• Innovation - engage with cutting edge programmable logic technology in demanding signal processing applications

• Unique experience - get hands on with spaceflight hardware

• Solve challenging problems - work at the intersection of space systems, data platforms, and climate innovation

• Work in a mission-driven environment - join a team that values purpose, technical excellence, and thoughtful execution

description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The Enterprise SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. Enterprise SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The Enterprise SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

- Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology - Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion - Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters - Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

- Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

- Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

- Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

- Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

- Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

- Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

- At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

- A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

- Fluent in German and conversational in English.

title: Senior Medical Director - GI

At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word-a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care-we’re changing lives.
We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: “What would I do if this patient were my mom?” That question drives everything we do.
But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare-driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.
Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.
Position Summary
Caris is seeking a board-certified expert in Medical Oncology with deep experience in GI malignancies to join our Medical Affairs team as Senior Medical Director, GI.
Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Medical Affairs and Chair of the Precision Oncology Alliance (POA), this individual will serve as a key strategic leader, scientific ambassador, and external face of Caris’ precision oncology platform.

The Senior Medical Director will blend clinical expertise, scientific credibility, and communication excellence to educate and inspire oncologists, researchers, and healthcare stakeholders worldwide-highlighting the transformative potential of Caris molecular.

Job Responsibilities

• Serve as the senior clinical and scientific voice for Caris in GI oncology, representing the company at national and international meetings, academic institutions, and major cancer centers.

• Partner with internal stakeholders across R&D, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Business Development, and Marketing to ensure clinical accuracy, alignment, and innovation in messaging and product positioning.

• Advise on clinical strategy and evidence generation to support Caris’ growing presence in GI oncology, including input on prospective trials, retrospective analyses, and real-world data initiatives.

• Contribute thought leadership to Caris’ scientific communications-advisory boards, symposia, webinars, publications, and slide decks that convey Caris’ scientific differentiation.

• Provide clinical mentorship to field-based medical personnel (e.g., Medical Science Liaisons), enhancing their effectiveness in customer engagement and scientific storytelling.

• Collaborate on content development for GI oncology education programs, internal trainings, and professional/continuing medical education (CME) initiatives.

• Bridge insights from the field to internal teams, ensuring the evolving needs of GI oncologists and researchers inform product innovation and R&D priorities.

Required Qualifications

• MD or DO, board-certified in Medical Oncology (and/or Internal Medicine) with significant clinical experience in GI oncology.

• Proven excellence in scientific communication, public speaking, and KOL engagement at major oncology forums or academic settings.

• Demonstrated leadership in translating clinical and molecular insights into actionable strategies that advance product adoption or inform evidence generation.

• Strong executive presence, interpersonal skills, and ability to influence across scientific, clinical, and commercial domains.
